_description: Commit-specific fixes for SGLang benchmarks. This config handles package incompatibilities and code structure changes when overlaying old code onto newer Docker images.

33b242df303e03886835d08a583fefe979a3ee88.description: Base commit for PR #420 (Optimize logits processor memory)

issues.cause: outlines library reorganized FSM module in newer versions
sglang.srt.utils changed from single file to package directory between commits

fixes.notes: The code structure changed significantly between base and head commits. utils.py became utils/ package, causing import incompatibilities. Best approach: use Docker image directly for both baseline and human, since the performance difference comes from the specific optimization, not overlay.

_default_fixes.description: Default fixes to try if commit not found in config

_overlay_strategy.description: The overlay approach has fundamental limitations
problems: Code structure changes (file -> directory, renamed functions)
_overlay_strategy.recommended_solution: For SGLang, consider using commit-specific Docker images like vLLM does, OR benchmark only the human optimization (Docker image) without trying to recreate exact base commit behavior
